title: A queue that never shifts

starter.solution.lua:
Queue = {}
Queue.__index = Queue

function Queue.new() return setmetatable({ items = {} }, Queue) end
function Queue:push(v) table.insert(self.items, v) end
function Queue:pop() return table.remove(self.items, 1) end
function Queue:size() return #self.items end

solution.solution.lua:
Queue = {}
Queue.__index = Queue

function Queue.new() return setmetatable({ first = 1, last = 0 }, Queue) end

function Queue:push(v)
    self.last = self.last + 1
    self[self.last] = v
end

function Queue:pop()
    if self.first > self.last then return nil end
    local v = self[self.first]
    self[self.first] = nil
    self.first = self.first + 1
    return v
end

function Queue:peek()
    if self.first > self.last then return nil end
    return self[self.first]
end

function Queue:size() return self.last - self.first + 1 end
function Queue:isEmpty() return self.first > self.last end

hints: `push` increases `last` and stores there; `pop` reads at `first`, clears it and increases `first` (lesson 8.01).
The queue is empty when `first > last`; test that instead of looking at the value, because a stored `false` is not empty.
unitTests:
test("first in, first out", function()
    local q = Queue.new()
    q:push("a"); q:push("b"); q:push("c")
    check_eq(q:size(), 3)
    check_eq(q:pop(), "a")
    check_eq(q:peek(), "b")
    q:push("d")
    check_eq({ q:pop(), q:pop(), q:pop() }, { "b", "c", "d" })
    check(q:isEmpty())
    check_eq(q:pop(), nil)
    check_eq(q:peek(), nil)
end)

test("false is a value", function()
    local q = Queue.new()
    q:push(false)
    check_eq(q:size(), 1)
    check_eq(q:pop(), false)
    check(q:isEmpty())
end)

test("no shifting: the slots are moved past", function()
    local q = Queue.new()
    for i = 1, 1000 do q:push(i) end
    for _ = 1, 999 do q:pop() end
    check_eq(q.first, 1000)
    check_eq(q[1], nil)
    check_eq(q:pop(), 1000)
end)
